messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":6,"verses":[{"chapter":6,"verse":16,"text":"16 Therefore, write in a letter: ‘Say to the children of Israel: Let the stranger who comes among you be set apart and let 15 days go by; and after this I will lead you into your city, says the Lord."},{"chapter":6,"verse":17,"text":"17 He who is not separated from Babylon will not enter into the city; and I will punish them by keeping them from being received back by the Babylonians, says the Lord.’”"},{"chapter":6,"verse":18,"text":"18 And when the angel had said this, he departed from Baruch."},{"chapter":6,"verse":19,"text":"19 And Baruch sent to the market of the gentiles and got papyrus and ink and wrote a letter with these words: “Baruch, the servant of God, writes to Jeremiah in the captivity of Babylon:"},{"chapter":6,"verse":20,"text":"20 “Greetings! Rejoice, for God has not allowed us to depart from this body grieving for the city which was devastated and mistreated."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
